value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"The in-house modem now ships in the base iPhone 18 and the iPad line.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"in-house modem (C2) shipping in base iPhone 18 and iPad line","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"The expert said Apple's internal target for the 2027 iPhone cycle was to carry C2 in roughly half of all units, including some Pro models.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"internal target share of iPhone units with C2 modem","period":"2027","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"In her last quarter at Apple, that target was \"under review\" because the Pro-tier carrier certification slipped.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"C2 target mix status","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"Two issues: sub-6 throughput in dense urban deployments at two large U.S. carriers, and a wafer-level yield issue on the RF transceiver die that held effective supply below plan.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"C2 modem issues (sub-6 throughput, RF transceiver die yield)","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"She believes Qualcomm will keep supplying most Pro-tier modems through 2027, with Apple's modem content cost savings per unit coming in about $8-11 below what internal planning had assumed ($18-22 per unit at target mix).","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":["Qualcomm"],"kind":"opinion","metric":"Qualcomm Pro-tier modem supply and modem content cost savings per unit","period":"2027","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"At full planned mix the expert said Finance had counted roughly 40-60bp of annual iPhone gross margin benefit from the modem swap.
